nodes.title: SG-4.2.3 · Enforce the tracked-dependency check in the test script
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts has trackedNodeModulesPaths, untrackNodeModules and assertNoTrackedNodeModules, but nothing runs them and package.json test is plain `vitest run`. Desired behavior: a null-separated git ls-files check (checkTrackedFiles, parseGitLsFiles), a guard CLI script, and a test script that runs the guard before vitest. Expected result: npm test fails if a dependency or test-cache path is tracked. Why: stops vendored Phaser files from being committed again.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given git ls-files -z output containing a node_modules or .vite/vitest path, When checkTrackedFiles runs, Then it reports that path.
- Given a tracked dependency path, When the guard CLI logic runs, Then it prints the paths and returns a non-zero exit code.
- Given package.json, When the test script is read, Then it runs the guard before vitest run.
- Given tsc --noEmit, When run, Then tests/trackedNodeModules.test.ts and the new guard tests produce no type errors.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/package.json test script
- In scope: unit tests with a fake git runner
- Out of scope: Changing git history
- Out of scope: Phaser runtime code
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Existing trackedNodeModulesPaths, untrackNodeModules, assertNoTrackedNodeModules behavior and exports
- Preserve: untrack:node-modules script


## Technical constraints
- vite-node runs the guard script (already used by untrack:node-modules)
- No duplicate exports in the helper file
- Unit tests use a fake git runner, never real git


## Definition of done
- All three requirements have passing unit tests
- npm test script includes the guard


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · checkTrackedFiles and parseGitLsFiles report tracked dependency and vitest-cache paths
nodes.body:
Context: helper file only filters node_modules segments from a string array. Desired behavior: parseGitLsFiles splits null-separated output and drops empty entries; checkTrackedFiles(run) runs git ls-files -z and returns every path under node_modules or in the vitest cache. Expected result: one export of each name, no duplicates. Why: a single testable detection point for the guard.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given 'a\0b\0' , When parseGitLsFiles runs, Then it returns ['a','b'] with no empty entry.
- Given a runner returning 'src/a.ts\0node_modules/x.js\0', When checkTrackedFiles runs, Then it returns ['node_modules/x.js'] and the runner was called with ['ls-files','-z'].
- Given a path 'game/frontend/node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json', When checkTrackedFiles runs, Then it is reported.
- Given the helper file, When parsed, Then each helper name is exported exactly once.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- Out of scope: CLI script
- Out of scope: package.json
- Preserve: trackedNodeModulesPaths semantics (segment match, look-alike names not matched)


## Technical constraints
- Reuse GitRunner type and trackedNodeModulesPaths
- Vitest cache = path containing the segments .vite/vitest


## Definition of done
- Helpers exported once and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Guard CLI script prints tracked paths and exits non-zero
nodes.body:
Add runGuard(run, log) returning an exit code in the helper module and a script scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts that wires execFileSync git and process.exit. Why: npm test needs an executable gate.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a runner listing a tracked node_modules path, When runGuard runs, Then it logs that path and returns 1.
- Given a runner listing only source paths, When runGuard runs, Then it returns 0 and logs nothing offending.
- Given the repo, When git ls-files lists the script, Then scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts exists and is tracked.


## Scope
- In scope: helper module runGuard
- In scope: guard script file
- Out of scope: package.json
- Preserve: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts


## Technical constraints
- Script uses execFileSync from node:child_process like untrackNodeModules.ts


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Script file exists and is committed

- None
